key_insight: A continual transfer learning framework with model selection can speed up UAV trajectory optimization in O-RAN by reusing the most relevant prior environment knowledge instead of retraining from scratch.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster and more practical deployment of UAV-based open radio units for adaptive 6G coverage in changing urban environments.
method: Maintain a library of pre-trained trajectory models from different environments
Select the most relevant source model for transfer learning based on similarity
Use a fallback continuously refined model when no suitable prior model exists
evidence_signal: Simulation results using real-world city maps and ray tracing show 44% to 56% faster convergence than training from scratch and up to 40% improvement over standard transfer learning.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and coverage of the model library and the reliability of environment similarity selection in new scenarios.
paper_title: Adaptive Machine Learning Framework for UAV Trajectory Optimization in O-RAN
